q: The moment of inertia of a particle of mass $m$ at distance $r$ from the axis of rotation is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. The moment of inertia of a particle of mass m at distance r from the axis of rotation is mr². mr or m/r² is a different relation from mr².

q: The moment of inertia of an object is defined as the sum of the products obtained by multiplying the mass of each particle and the _____ of its distance from the axis.
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. The moment of inertia of an object is defined as the sum of the products obtained by multiplying the mass of each particle and the square of its distance from the axis. Do not trade square for cube or first power.

q: The SI unit of moment of inertia is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. The SI unit of moment of inertia is kg m². kg m or N m is a different relation from kg m².

q: Moment of inertia must be specified with respect to a chosen _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. Moment of inertia must be specified with respect to a chosen axis of rotation. Center of mass or pivot point is not this quantity.

q: For a solid sphere rotating about its axis, the moment of inertia is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. For a solid sphere rotating about its axis, the moment of inertia is (2)/(5) MR². (1)/(2) MR² or MR² is a different relation from (2)/(5) MR².

q: For a hoop or cylindrical shell rotating about its central axis, the moment of inertia is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. For a hoop or cylindrical shell rotating about its central axis, the moment of inertia is MR². (1)/(2) MR² or (1)/(12) ML² is a different relation from MR².

q: For a long thin rod rotating about an axis through its center and perpendicular to its length, the moment of inertia is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. For a long thin rod rotating about an axis through its center and perpendicular to its length, the moment of inertia is (1)/(12) ML². (1)/(3) ML² or ML² is a different relation from (1)/(12) ML².

q: For a long thin rod rotating about an axis through one end and perpendicular to its length, the moment of inertia is _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. For a long thin rod rotating about an axis through one end and perpendicular to its length, the moment of inertia is (1)/(3) ML². (1)/(12) ML² or (1)/(2) ML² is a different relation from (1)/(3) ML².

q: The relationship between torque $\tau$, moment of inertia $I$, and angular acceleration $\alpha$ is _____
e: Angular acceleration is the rate of change of angular velocity, dω/dt. The relationship between torque tau, moment of inertia I, and angular acceleration α is tau = I α. tau = I / α or tau = α / I is a different relation from tau = I α.

q: The center of gravity of an object of regular shape and uniform density is located at its _____
e: Density is mass per unit volume, ρ = m/V. The center of gravity of an object of regular shape and uniform density is located at its geometrical center. Do not trade geometrical center for bottom edge or top surface.
